PlayTorrio v1.1.15 iOS-only subtitle recovery release. Reject invalid subtitle payloads and downloads without timed cues; validate SRT, VTT and ASS; verify MPV subtitle track selection and restore native subtitle visibility; retry URI-based attachment with data attachment when required. Native libass is the default on iOS unless an explicitly saved renderer preference overrides it. Preserve signed iOS 15 TrollStore packaging, VideoToolbox, Apple Speech and audio sync, and SHA256-pinned FFmpeg/libmpv Night Mode acompressor, compand and alimiter. Linux/Windows source regression CI 41309000680 succeeded. Physical subtitle visibility and audible Night Mode effectiveness still require owner-device verification; no Windows build is requested.
